title: Florida National Guard departs for search and rescue operations
description: Florida Army National Guard Soldiers with 1-111th General Support Aviation Regiment, along with members of North Central Florida Urban Search and Rescue Task Force 8 depart for possible search and rescue mission onboard a Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter during Hurricane Helene support operations at Army Aviation Support Facility 1, Fla., Sept. 27, 2024. 1-111th GSAR provide aviation support to affected areas following  a storm's landfall.
